UpgradeRecord.description: 12-byte firmware-upgrade record: kept in flash at 0x0801F800 and mirrored in RAM at 0x200020D0 (vcu_upgrade_record_store writes it, vcu_crypto_identity_record_init reads it).

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Record tag. It must equal the built-in default at 0x200014BC, otherwise the record is replaced by that default at start-up.

fields.name: pending
fields.description: 1 when a complete, verified image is staged and must be installed on the next reset (probably). Set by update sub-command 9, cleared when sub-command 7 starts a transfer.

fields.name: image_size
fields.description: Size in bytes of the staged image, copied from DAT_2000149C when the update completes.

DeviceId.description: 6-byte device identifier held in RAM at 0x20001C7C, compared with the copy in flash at 0x08001430.

fields.name: word0
fields.description: First four identifier bytes, little-endian as stored by the identity write.
